I had an accident that caused a laceration on my right eyebrow with significant bleeding and pain, and I went to Samui Home Clinic, Chaweng, one of the most well-known clinics on the island. From the moment I arrived, the reception staff, nurse aides, and nursing team immediately rushed to assist me with genuine kindness, empathy, and professionalism, which made me feel safe and well cared for.

Dr. Aratchaporn Kunasol (Dr. Pleng) attended to me promptly and compassionately 🙏🏻🥰. She administered local anesthesia very gently and painlessly before suturing. During the procedure, her technique was exceptionally delicate and highly professional, and she closed the wound beautifully.

The entire team—including the nurses (Registered Nurse Bam), nurse aide Pin, and the reception staff (Khun Lady Ford)—was consistently kind, professional, attentive, and empathetic. Their warmth and sincerity truly stood out. They provide excellent care for patients from all over the world, with outstanding attention to detail throughout pre-treatment, treatment, and post-treatment.

I am extremely appreciative of Dr. Pleng and her team. The clinic genuinely prioritizes patient care with remarkable kindness and empathy. The staff communicate in excellent English, the clinic is very clean, and they provide thorough and clear advice on wound care and follow-up until suture removal.

Despite the high standard of specialist care, the pricing is very reasonable compared with other medical centers. I highly recommend this clinic not only for emergency care, but also for general medical care, family medicine, preventive care, and dermatologic conditions. 🙏🏻❤️

Samui Home Clinic is fantastic.

The staff are always friendly and helpful and professional. From visits with the dermatologist, to labs, to just regular doctors visits, every time I have come has been a good experience. Prices are very reasonable and appointments are promptly kept.

Ask anyone on the island, and this place is their first recommendation.
Best clinic. Pretty nurses. Clean room. No waiting. We party last night.   I will come here again.

Very helpful and attentive nurses. I had abrasion wounds and they cleaned and treated them for 3 days and provided me with advice and support. There was no waiting time and the whole process was very efficient.
The best clinic I’ve been to! Reasonable prices, The place is super clean and hygienic, and the doctor is really professional and genuinely caring. I honestly recommend this place 100% ❤️🩷 …
Fantastic staff, they were all extremely friendly and reassuring. Got my test results back within 10 minutes and prescribed me everything that I needed. Thank you all 😊 …

I came to this new clinic to clean a wound, and  the service and advice provided were excellent. Doctor is knowledgeable and nurses very kind and helpful. I am very glad we have this new clinic in Chaweng. This is  huge service improvement for both tourists and expats living here.

Professional doctors and nurses. Took one look at my problem and knew immediately waht it was and how to fix me up. Started off as a pimple on elbow which (don't ever try yourself) I tried to pop, big mistake absess in elbow followed with massive pain and swealing..
Doctor at clinic asked of I need local anaesthetic I didn't want but lanced infected area straight onto a antibiotic drip, all dressed super well.. had to return each fay to get wound cleaned and further antibiotic drip (it was pretty bad) anyway I cam back 4 days more for same, clean, drip, dress.. finally today it was good enough for no more drip amd dressing didn't need applied.

Back to review of  clinic 😀 it was great super clean super friendly staff.. I had insurance but really just for accident so I paid my own... very reasonable price 900 baht this for drip, for clean, for dressing for piece of mind from professional doctor amd nurses.

Hope I do t need to come back again but of I did this is the place I wouod go.. recommend for any problem you might have .

Keep safe

Thank you samui home clinic chaweng

Excellent efficient clinic in Chaweng.  My daughter was very poorly with an infection & fever.  We checked the clinic website which you can book online an appointment but we didn’t want to wait so we called and were able to come immediately. My daughter was seen in just a few minutes, had blood test, urine test, IV & antibiotics all very promptly.  The doctor communicated what was wrong and we decided that our daughter would come daily for observation & tests & treatment..  We felt she was in very professional hands and we recommend the Clinic as it’s very clean & efficient.
The price for initial consultation, tests and medicine & nearly 4 hours in a bed it was less than £100. The follow up consultation & IV/ antibiotic treatment was approx £12.50 per day  in this day and age of poor medical facilities this clinic provided exceptional care for an exceptional price.

The staff here are worth their weight in gold. I got ill when I landed in Samui (illness caught elsewhere) and with luck, I found this clinic on Google Maps just down the road.

I have never been more grateful to the staff who sent a car to my hotel because I was unable to walk to the clinic, took care of me and arranged for me to get back to the hotel that night. They also worked 3 hours over their shift to make sure I was okay to leave. Their prices are incredibly reasonable and their ability to communicate in English was also really helpful and reassuring.

I wouldn’t hesitate on recommending them for medical treatment, and would also recommend going sooner than you think you need, because I felt better almost instantly. They also arranged further tests and treatment on the days after to ensure I was fighting fit. Highly recommend.
Extremely good . The Dr takes great care and examines every part of skin to treat for sun damage
Staff here are very welcoming, nice and helpful, I got our customized— with Nad, liver detox drip plus add ons and my bf post covid drip. Highly recommended this clinic.

Always receive professional help here if needed. Good doctors, faster service than in hospitals. Better prices.
Nice stuff.
Staff was great! Professional and knowledgeable, made the process fast and easy. I will definitely be back.

Samui Home Clinic: The nurses and the doctor were incredibly attentive during our visit. We were a group of four, with one of us severely hungover. The clinic offered several IV options, and we quickly started treatment. The facility is clean and modern, featuring leather recliners for relaxing during the infusion. Each of the treatments worked wonders, but the most surprising and visibly effective result was the hangover IV – it was shockingly successful. If you're in need of medical attention or just a quick recovery boost, Samui Home Clinic is the place to go.
Very nice doctors. Clean clinic and very fair prices. Highly recommend!
Lovely clinic, convenient location and super friendly staff. Highly recommended :)
My wife got treatmemt very quickly with stokach issues. Very clean and polite personnel. Highly reccomend to everyone with issues.
Lovely staff, they also help with wonds and stitches for motorbike accidents, very good caring, and cheaper than other clinics. They removed my stitches, and they are very professional.
Had the NAD Drip absolutely amazing! The clinic is super clean very professional and the staff made us feel super comfortable! Highly recommend

Visited after a food poisoning incident – very competent and professional staff. No waiting time, everything was clean and well organized. I felt well taken care of throughout the visit. Highly recommended.

I have become a regular at Samui Clinic for IVs over the past two years. Their products are excellent and the nurses gentle especially with the administration of NAD+ for which I have really felt the results and those around me can see.

I had an excellent experience at Samui Home Clinic – Chaweng Beach while receiving my IV drip treatment. The staff was incredibly professional, kind, and attentive, ensuring my comfort throughout the entire process. The clinic is clean, well-organized, and provides a relaxing atmosphere, making the experience smooth and stress-free.

The medical team explained everything clearly, answered all my questions, and checked on me throughout the procedure to make sure I was feeling well. Their expertise and care were truly reassuring. I highly recommend Samui Home Clinic to anyone looking for top-quality medical care on Koh Samui!
I had food poisoning, and they arranged a doctor and 2 nurses to my house, the whole treatment and after care was amazing and very affordable. Highly recommend!
Thank you. Very good and pleasant service. Good prices 🙏 …

I am a visiting tourist and had some urgent need of care. One morning I started sneezing and my ears feels so itchy and have to be attended in Chaweng Branch Samui Home clinic. I was attended first hand immediately and I just need to send a copy of my passport  and then I was attended by Dr Kunasol. She is so caring and attentive and detailed and everything felt right during my emergency visit. Much Love from the Philippines

This clinic was immaculate! The staff were incredibly friendly and very professional. They offer so many options and my test results were given to me very quickly. I also shopped around and found it was a third of the price here over the hospitals for my blood work! I highly recommend this clinic!

I came to this clinic recommended by my hostel because I thought I had tonsillitis and was really unwell. Bew saw me straight away and did swabs and blood tests, they realised it was more of a serious bacterial infection so gave me an iv drip for hydration and an iv drip of antibiotics. I had to come back the next day and they gave me one more drip and all the medication I would need. They were so helpful and made me feel really safe when I was most vulnerable. I recommend coming here as you’ll be looked after.

I went there after getting a splinter in my foot.
I was greeted by a very nice staff and was well taken care of.
The clinic was very clean and nice.
Anesthetic injection, chip removal, bandages and a handy bag to cover the foot with when showering. This cost 1100B! A very nice price.
Recommended.
Amazing service and excellent professional staff , priced average and well managed

I visited this clinic for an NAD+ IV drip, but unfortunately, my experience was very concerning. The staff had significant difficulty finding my veins, resulting in multiple failed attempts. This caused me to faint and ultimately required a visit to the emergency room. I’ve received NAD+ IV treatments before, both in my home country and in Bangkok, and I’ve never experienced anything this unsafe or unprofessional. Based on this experience, I wouldn’t recommend this clinic at this time. I hope they take this feedback seriously and improve their procedures to ensure patient safety moving forward.

I suffer from occasional fainting and after feeling close to fainting a couple of times since yesterday I knew I needed a saline drip just to rehydrate myself.

I attended the clinic today and was taken care of superbly.

My blood pressure, heart rate and blood sugar was checked followed by just a regular saline drip.

The nurse was excellent, I didn’t even feel her putting in or taking out the needle.

Clinic was clean and very professional. Would recommend.

Price was very reasonable.

Note the car park has a sign saying it costs ฿100 but if you say you are going to (and point to the clinic) parking is free.
